prompts.thorn: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: two-frame pixel sprite strip for a rose plant firing a thorn projectile in a dungeon game. TWO equal square cells side by side, transparent background. Each cell: a sharp emerald-green wooden THORN spear pointing exactly RIGHT, rose-red tip accents, two tiny crimson rose petals trailing to its LEFT. Strong pointed arrowhead and jagged organic green barb silhouette, thin fast projectile, not flower bouquet, not gun bullet, not laser. Frame0 intact needle with short green trail, frame1 same orientation and head position with slightly dispersed petal trail. Crisp chunky pixel-art readable after downsampling32x32, about80% cell width, keep central narrow half-height, no text labels grids scene or ground. Reference is original rose summon for green/crimson palette only. 2:1 strip.
prompts.bloom: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: ultimate rose garden BLOOM explosion pixel VFX strip. TWO equal square cells side by side, transparent background. Top-down epic radial burst of scarlet/crimson ROSES, curling emerald thorn vines and flying red/pink petals across a SQUARE footprint. Frame0 four large rose buds flowering at diagonal corners, thorn arcs emerging outwards and petals bursting, frame1 fully opened red roses and dispersing petals. A large transparent empty centre at least60% cell width so dungeon characters remain visible. Sparse disconnected petals and sharp thorn starbursts toward edges, no solid filled ring, no decorative picture frame, no text, no ground, no characters, no UI. Strong crimson rose identity, deep green vines, ivory and gold small magical glints; crisp detailed pixel art with hard pixel edges. Will be imported as224x224 per frame, so preserve readable detail at that scale. 2:1 transparent horizontal strip. Reference is original rose summon palette, develop a spectacular full garden bloom.
